name: cross-file-preservation
description: A selected feature-plan pair has required headings, task state and linked deployment gates. Stage test-files/ as a separate workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor. The editor sees only those files and the target skill; oracle/ is grader-only.
prompt: $kk:clarify-docs design.md and tasks.md for the developer resuming this feature. requirements.md is evidence; entry.md is an inbound-link reference. Edit only design.md and tasks.md.
trap: Renames anchors or deletes task state, optionality and deployment gates during reorganization.

assertions.text: All five reader answers are supported through design.md and tasks.md and retain planned versus implemented status.
Fidelity: retain required sections, MUST columns id,name, MAY diagnostics, Mira's acceptance date, support approval gate and product-owned duplicate policy.
Preserve every task status, checkbox and dependency exactly.
Both existing inbound links from entry.md and both cross-file links still resolve; entry.md and requirements.md are unchanged.
Orientation: explain preview before the admission-observation terminology; show the three-row case without implying count implementation is complete.
